description: FS1 Solar Site Overview - No Longer Used is a dataset listed in Town of Morrisville Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Town of Morrisville; Solar Edge. This dataset is no longer updating. The data has been combined with other solar installations across town and condensed into a single dataset for all of the Town of Morrisville Solar Arrays. That dataset can be found here:. Coverage: Morrisville, North Carolina. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are solar. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2026-06-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-townofmorrisville-org-portal.
